def conc_cent(mask):
    m = mask
    bits = []
    sr = 0
    sc = 0
    while m:

        m ^= lsb
        i = lsb.bit_length() - 1

    cent = 0

        c = i & 7
        dr = r - mr
        dc = c - mc
        s += sqrt(dr * dr + dc * dc)
        cent += CENT[i]
    return s / n, cent
